---
name: Domain skill request
about: Propose a focused mathematics, science, technology, education, or research skill
title: "[Domain skill]: "
labels: skill-request, domain-skill
---

## Domain and recurring problem

Which domain is this for, and what recurring task or failure should the skill address?

## Proposed trigger and boundary

When should an agent load this skill? Which nearby requests should remain with an existing skill?

## Method and handoff

What should the skill classify, select, calculate, explain, build, or report? What should the final handoff contain?

## Verification or evidence

How should an agent check correctness, units, assumptions, reproducibility, accessibility, uncertainty, or source support? Include authoritative public references, standards, or versioned documentation.

## Education, laboratory, or operational safety

If the proposal involves tutoring, exams, physical systems, experiments, data, networks, or regulated topics, describe the safe boundary. Confirm that it will not expose private data, enable exam circumvention, provide unsafe lab instructions, or assume unauthorized access.

## Overlap and acceptance example

Which existing skills did you review, why is a new module justified, and what representative input should a maintainer use to test it?
